Definition: Shalman, a king apparently of Assyria
BiblicalUsage: Shalman is named once, as the spoiler of Beth-arbel in the day of battle. Hosea uses his name as a byword for sudden destruction, when all the fortresses of Israel shall be spoiled as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that one mention is enough to make a king a byword, when his cruelty is the measure of the judgment to come.
